_comment: Escalation chains. Each chain links a confirmed primitive into a higher-impact outcome. BlitzStrike edge vs other catalogs: every step carries an invariant_check (what MUST hold) and a negative_control (how to refute). Never hardcode in Python — edit here.

chains.name: SSRF to Cloud Metadata Exfiltration

steps.action: Confirm SSRF with a callback to an attacker-controlled server
steps.success_criteria: DNS/HTTP callback received with target IP
steps.invariant_check: URL is fetched server-side without host allowlist
steps.negative_control: same URL through a non-vulnerable endpoint produces no callback

steps.action: Probe cloud metadata endpoint
steps.invariant_check: no egress filter on metadata IP
steps.negative_control: metadata request from own host returns 403/empty

steps.action: Exfiltrate IAM credentials
steps.invariant_check: IMDSv1 enabled (no token header required)
steps.negative_control: request without X-aws-ec2-metadata-token still blocked = IMDSv2

chains.name: LFI via Log Poisoning to RCE

steps.action: Inject PHP into web server logs via User-Agent header
steps.invariant_check: include path can reach /var/log/* without is_file() wrapper-block
steps.negative_control: is_file() on a php:// wrapper path returns false

steps.action: Trigger inclusion of the poisoned log
steps.invariant_check: include uses a path attacker controls, not a fixed safe path
steps.negative_control: non-poisoned log include returns only plain text (no exec)

chains.name: Polyglot Upload to RCE (server-config dependent)

steps.action: Craft JPEG+PHP polyglot (valid image header + PHP payload)
steps.success_criteria: file passes MIME/extension check as image/jpeg
steps.invariant_check: upload validation checks extension AND magic bytes but not execution
steps.negative_control: pure .php is rejected by the same endpoint

steps.action: Access uploaded file via web path
steps.invariant_check: server handler matches .php inside filename (no $ anchor) OR dir has no .htaccess
steps.negative_control: default Apache FilesMatch .+\.ph(ar|p|tml)$ does NOT execute .php.jpg

chains.name: APP_KEY Leak to Deserialization RCE

steps.action: Read leaked APP_KEY (no .htaccess, .env exposed, debug error)
steps.invariant_check: app_key file is served directly (RewriteCond !-f passes existing files)
steps.negative_control: file returns 404/403 = protected

steps.action: Generate PHPGGC gadget (Monolog RCE2/RCE8)
steps.invariant_check: vendor has Monolog/Symfony gadget class
steps.negative_control: unserialize with allowed_classes=['...'] blocks the chain

steps.action: Encrypt gadget with APP_KEY and POST to decrypt endpoint
steps.success_criteria: sleep timing / webhook / file write confirms RCE
steps.invariant_check: Crypt::decrypt() calls unserialize() on attacker input
steps.negative_control: same payload against a non-decrypt route returns error

chains.name: Empty HMAC Key Signature Forgery

steps.action: Confirm HMAC key defaults to empty/false
steps.success_criteria: get_option('secret') returns false on fresh install
steps.invariant_check: hash_hmac(key) uses get_option() WITHOUT wp_salt() and WITHOUT empty() guard
steps.negative_control: hash_hmac with wp_salt() key cannot be forged without wp-config

steps.action: Forge token with empty key and submit
steps.invariant_check: token verified with hash_equals against forgeable value
steps.negative_control: empty() guard present = token rejected

chains.name: Nonce Harvest to Broken Authorization

steps.action: Scrape nonce from frontend HTML/JS (user ID 0 nonce is global)
steps.invariant_check: nonce is CSRF protection, NOT authorization
steps.negative_control: current_user_can() gate present blocks the action regardless of nonce

steps.action: Replay privileged AJAX action with harvested nonce
steps.invariant_check: handler checks nonce only, no capability check
steps.negative_control: same action with bad nonce fails = nonce is a real gate

chains.name: intval() Truthy-Check Bypass

steps.action: Test negative/large form IDs against intval() != 0 gate
steps.invariant_check: if (!$id) die() rejects only ZERO; any non-zero int is truthy
steps.negative_control: a real lookup (field-by-meta-name) returns false and rejects

steps.action: Exploit the bypassed handler (upload/submit)
steps.success_criteria: handler proceeds without a real form existing
steps.invariant_check: no form-existence check downstream
steps.negative_control: wp_insert_post form + custom-table row both required elsewhere

chains.name: extract() Variable Injection to LFI/RCE

steps.action: Find extract($array) without EXTR_SKIP where keys reach include/require
steps.success_criteria: extract() site where a key collides with a sink variable
steps.invariant_check: extract() without EXTR_SKIP lets array keys overwrite locals
steps.negative_control: EXTR_SKIP present = overwrite blocked

steps.action: POST colliding key to control the included path
steps.invariant_check: included variable is attacker-reachable from $_POST/$_REQUEST
steps.negative_control: unset() strips dangerous key at entry = safe

chains.name: PHP Type Juggling Auth Bypass

steps.action: Identify loose == / in_array without strict / strcmp==0 in auth path
steps.invariant_check: PHP '0e...' == '0e...', 'admin'==0, NULL==0, in_array(0,[...])=true
steps.negative_control: === or hash_equals() or in_array(...,true) = safe

steps.action: Craft payload that satisfies the loose check
steps.success_criteria: auth bypassed (e.g. 0 matches admin role string)
steps.invariant_check: comparison not gated by a prior capability check
steps.negative_control: capability check before comparison blocks it

chains.name: Split-Controller Upload Bypass

steps.action: Identify check task vs write task in same controller
steps.success_criteria: check task guarded, write task unguarded
steps.invariant_check: write task callable directly without passing check task
steps.negative_control: JSession::checkToken() present in write task = blocked

steps.action: POST directly to write task with shell file
steps.success_criteria: file written to web-accessible dir, PHP executes
steps.invariant_check: no $user->authorise() and no JFile extension check in write task
steps.negative_control: write task re-validates extension = safe

chains.name: Race Condition Double-Spend / Double-Use

steps.action: Identify check-then-act without atomic reservation
steps.success_criteria: existence check and use not atomic
steps.invariant_check: check and act happen in a window another process can enter
steps.negative_control: fopen('x') / atomic CAS / DB unique constraint blocks

steps.action: Fire 2+ concurrent requests to win the race
steps.invariant_check: no serialization of read-modify-write
steps.negative_control: single-threaded replay does not duplicate

chains.name: IDOR to Mass Data Access

steps.action: Enumerate sequential IDs on a data endpoint
steps.success_criteria: other user's resource returned with modified ID
steps.invariant_check: no ownership check on object reference
steps.negative_control: access to own ID works but other ID returns 403

steps.action: Extract PII / sensitive data across all IDs
steps.invariant_check: no rate limit / scope check
steps.negative_control: object ownership middleware present

chains.name: SSTI to RCE

steps.action: Reflect {{7*7}} / ${7*7} in a template parameter
steps.invariant_check: user input reaches template engine without auto-escape
steps.negative_control: literal {{7*7}} returned = not evaluated

steps.action: Escalate to code execution (os.system / eval via template)
steps.invariant_check: engine exposes os/exec primitives and sandbox absent
steps.negative_control: sandboxed engine returns error on os access

chains.name: SQL Injection to RCE (via write/read primitives)

steps.action: Confirm SQLi with UNION SELECT / boolean / time-based
steps.invariant_check: input reaches raw query without prepared statement
steps.negative_control: prepared statement returns no injection difference

steps.action: Escalate via FILE privilege (INTO OUTFILE to webroot / LOAD_FILE)
steps.invariant_check: DB user has FILE privilege + webroot writable
steps.negative_control: secure_file_priv restricts writes

chains.name: Path Traversal to Arbitrary File Write

steps.action: Traverse ../ out of intended dir in a write/download param
steps.invariant_check: path used without realpath containment / basename strip
steps.negative_control: basename() / realpath containment blocks ../

steps.action: Write to a runtime-loadable location (cron, authorized_keys, webroot)
steps.invariant_check: written file loaded by runtime (CF-003)
steps.negative_control: file written but never included = not RCE

chains.name: JWT Algorithm Confusion Forgery

steps.action: Test alg=none / RS256→HS256 confusion
steps.invariant_check: server does not pin algorithm / reuses public key as HMAC secret
steps.negative_control: alg pinned + separate secret = rejected

steps.action: Forge admin claims and replay
steps.invariant_check: claims trusted without signature-appropriate verification
steps.negative_control: signature verified against correct key = forgery fails

chains.name: Web Cache Poisoning to Stored XSS

steps.action: Find reflected unkeyed header (X-Forwarded-Host, X-Forwarded-Scheme)
steps.success_criteria: header value reflected in cached response
steps.invariant_check: header not part of cache key but reflected in body
steps.negative_control: reflection not cached (no X-Cache: hit) = not persistent

steps.action: Inject script/redirect into cached response for victim
steps.success_criteria: poisoned cache served to other users
steps.invariant_check: CDN caches the poisoned variant
steps.negative_control: Vary header / keying prevents cross-user poisoning

chains.name: Dangling DNS to Subdomain Takeover

steps.action: Find CNAME pointing to unclaimed cloud service
steps.success_criteria: CNAME resolves to unclaimed/404 cloud endpoint
steps.invariant_check: service allows claiming the dangling resource
steps.negative_control: CNAME resolves to active claimed resource = not vulnerable

steps.action: Claim the resource and serve content on the victim subdomain
steps.invariant_check: no ownership verification on claim
steps.negative_control: claim rejected (already owned)

chains.name: CORS Misconfiguration to Data Theft

steps.action: Reflect arbitrary Origin with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true
steps.invariant_check: sensitive endpoint reflects origin with credentials
steps.negative_control: public/search endpoint without credentials = low impact

steps.action: Steal authenticated data via cross-origin fetch

steps.negative_control: SOP blocks because ACAO is fixed, not reflected

chains.name: PHP Object Injection POP Chain to RCE

steps.action: Confirm unserialize() on attacker-controlled data
steps.success_criteria: unserialize sink reachable from user input
steps.invariant_check: unserialize WITHOUT allowed_classes restriction
steps.negative_control: maybe_unserialize on DB-trusted data = not user-controlled

steps.action: Build POP chain from available gadgets (vendor autoload)

steps.negative_control: redirect fixed to allowlisted domain

steps.action: Chain redirect into OAuth flow to steal code/token

chains.name: Command Injection to OS Command Execution

steps.action: Inject metacharacters into a command-adjacent parameter
